stem.text: Alcohol X gives a yellow precipitate with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$.
What is the structure of X?

A.alt: Skeletal structure: cyclohexane ring with an OH group on one carbon and methyl groups on the adjacent carbon and on the carbon opposite the OH.

B.alt: Skeletal structure: cyclohexane ring with a CH2OH group and a methyl group on the adjacent carbon.

C.alt: Skeletal structure: cyclohexane ring with a methyl and an OH group on the same carbon, and a methyl on the carbon opposite.

D.alt: Skeletal structure: cyclohexane ring attached to a CH(OH)CH3 group.
